propositions: ADR files have duplicate numbers across the corpus (17 duplicates across 91 files; 22 files require renumbering to 0070-0091 based on landing date)
Per-number marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN serve as a collision-proof mechanism; two ADRs claiming the same number produce a git add/add conflict that cannot be auto-resolved
CI validation must assert bijection between ADRs and marker files, uniqueness of numbers, and referential integrity of all adr/NNNN-slug cross-references in docs/ and src/

References to moved ADRs must be rewritten to their new numbers; references to kept ADRs must remain valid; slug-bearing references are disambiguated by filename; bare references are recorded in RENUMBERING.md with resolution tier
A generated docs/adr/README.md index grouped by workstream and docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md mapping table document the renumbering and provide traceability
Moved ADRs carry a 'previously numbered' header; kept ADRs carry an ambiguity-window note
